item.name: Create User Account for Created Client
Create Individual Appointment with Seed Client
Try Overlapping Appointment for Same Client - Expected Conflict

body.raw:
{
  "appointmentType": "INDIVIDUAL",
  "serviceId": "{{seedServiceId}}",
  "instructorId": "{{seedInstructorId}}",
  "resourceId": "{{seedResourceId}}",
  "startAt": "{{appointmentStartAt}}",
  "endAt": "{{appointmentEndAt}}",
  "status": "SCHEDULED",
  "notes": "Expected to fail because same client overlaps.",
  "participantClientIds": [
    "{{seedClientId1}}"
  ],
  "capacity": 1
}

exec: pm.test('Expected conflict or business error', function () { pm.expect([400,409]).to.include(pm.response.code); });
